facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya says electronic certification service providers are licensed and accredited by it and listed on its Telecommunications Services Licensee Register.
facts.system: Electronic Certification Service Providers (E-CSPs) licensed by the Communications Authority

facts.fact: The Communications Authority notice requires all systems designated Critical Information Infrastructure to use digital certificates and PKI services only from E-CSPs it has licensed and accredited.
facts.system: Electronic Certification Service Providers (E-CSPs) licensed by the Communications Authority
